errorCodes.meaning: No election with this identifier exists for this community, or the caller may neither read its board nor is one of its trustees.

Dealing.description: A trustee's contribution to the election key: Feldman commitments to its polynomial, a proof of knowledge of the constant term, and one share per trustee sealed to that trustee's transport key (CONVENTIONS §9.6).
Dealing.title: Dealing

DecryptionTarget.description: What a partial decryption decrypts: the sealed cast at a board leaf, or the total of one option of one question.
DecryptionTarget.title: DecryptionTarget

ElGamalCiphertext.description: `(a, b) = (r·G, M + r·Y)` under the election key `Y` (CONVENTIONS §9.2).
ElGamalCiphertext.title: ElGamalCiphertext

ElectionId.description: An election's identifier, unique within its community. A closed alphabet: it appears in the ticket class label `voter/<electionId>` and is framed into every hash a cast is bound to.
ElectionId.title: ElectionId

ElectionKey.description: The election key and each trustee's public verification key, computed from the qualified dealings (CONVENTIONS §9.6). Anyone can recompute it from the board.

qualified.description: The dealers whose dealings the key is formed from.

ElectionKey.title: ElectionKey

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupElement.description: A Ristretto group element: its 32-byte compression, multibase base58btc. Never the identity (CONVENTIONS §9.1).
GroupElement.title: GroupElement

GroupScalar.description: A scalar mod the Ristretto group order: 32 canonical little-endian bytes, multibase base58btc (CONVENTIONS §9.1).
GroupScalar.title: GroupScalar

Key.description: A question or option key, unique within its manifest or question.
Key.title: Key

authorization.description: Once the community has authorized decryption: its voting/trustees/authorize request, as received. A trustee's VTA decrypts only the targets it pins.

decrypted.description: The trustees whose partials have been accepted.

steps.description: Every trusteeStep request on the board, in board order, as received. What a trustee's VTA acts on: the other members of this answer carry no trustee's proof.

targets.description: What remains to be decrypted, once voting has closed.

SealedPayload.description: Bytes sealed to a key: a random group element encrypted as `kem`, and the bytes under ChaCha20-Poly1305 with a key derived from it, multibase base58btc (CONVENTIONS §9.4).
SealedPayload.title: SealedPayload

SigmaProof.description: A non-interactive sigma proof as its challenge and response `(c, z)` (Schnorr or Chaum–Pedersen; CONVENTIONS §9.3).
SigmaProof.title: SigmaProof

SignedRequest.description: A whole Trust Task request document — `id`, `type`, `issuer`, `payload` and every other member, `proof` included — exactly as the ballot box received it, never re-serialised: its proof is taken over its members, and a re-serialised copy does not reliably reproduce them. Typed as an open object so every member survives; CONVENTIONS §9.6 gives the checks that make it a trustee's step.
SignedRequest.title: SignedRequest

TransportKey.description: The group element a trustee's shares are sealed to, with a Schnorr proof of knowledge of its discrete log (CONVENTIONS §9.6).
TransportKey.title: TransportKey

TrusteeCeremony.description: The trustees' ceremony as the board holds it: the `request` of every `trusteeStep` entry, in board order, each exactly as the ballot box received it (CONVENTIONS §9.6). Whoever acts on it verifies each step as its trustee's before taking it; nothing in it is believed for having been passed along.
TrusteeCeremony.title: TrusteeCeremony

TrusteeIndex.description: A trustee's index: its position in the manifest's `trustees.dids`, counting from 1.
TrusteeIndex.title: TrusteeIndex

TrusteePhase.description: `enrolling`: transport keys are being published. `dealing`: dealings are. `confirming`: each trustee confirms or complains. `keyed`: the election key is formed. `decrypting`: voting has closed and partial decryptions are being published. `done`: every target is decrypted. `failed`: the key could not be formed in time.
TrusteePhase.title: TrusteePhase

schema.description: Where an election's trustee ceremony stands: transport keys, dealings, complaints, the election key, and what remains to decrypt.

community.description: The community's DID: the registrar that registered the election.
